CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH  --------
For the Petitioner(s) : Md. Zaid Ahmed, Advocate
Mr. Kaushal Kishor Mishra, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shailendra Kumar Tiwari, A.P.P

03/ Dated 16.04.2024 Both these bail applications arise out of the same police case and as such, they are being disposed of by this common order.

The petitioners have been made accused in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No.40 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B), 66(C) & 66(D) of the Information Technology Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II cum Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-II cum Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On 15.12.2023, Cyber Police, Giridih apprehended several accused persons including the petitioners on suspicion that they were involved in cyber offence.
Mobile phone and other e-gadgets were recovered from their possession.
It was submitted that no victim has come forward to claim that he was cheated by the petitioners.

It was further submitted that similarly situated co-accused persons have been granted bail by this Md. Tanweer Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... .... Opp. ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118357131/
1 Court earlier.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioners, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioners, named above, are directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II cum Special Judge, Cyber Crime, Giridih, in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No.40 of 2023.
